notes.title: New Murtop Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Added[/h3]

[list]
[*] Better visual feedback when:
[list]
[*] Murti gets hit, specially by rocks and boulders (gameplay stops momentarly).
[*] Getting an extra life ("extra life" text shows).
[/list]
[*] MAME default keyboard arcade game controls:
[list]
[*] 5 (Coin slot 1).
[*] 1 (Player 1 start).
[*] Up Arrow (Player 1 Up).
[*] Down Arrow (Player 1 Down).
[*] Left Arrow (Player 1 Left).
[*] Right Arrow (Player 1 Right).
[*] Left Ctrl (Player 1 Button 1).
[*] Left Alt (Player 1 Button 2).
[*] Spacebar (Player 1 Button 3).
[/list]
[*] New languages: Catalan, Spanish, and Japanese.
[*] New Service menu (press and hold "1p_start" + "1p_button2" on the logos screen to access it). It contains:
[list]
[*] Options menu (same as in the "Title screen").
[*] Stats menu.
[*] Reset leadearboard.
[*] Reset stats.
[/list]
[*] TATE mode for "low end devices".
[*] The radish disappears afters 5 seconds.
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

[list]
[*] Credits are not reset anymore when not continuing.
[*] Font remapping when Japanese locale is set.
[*] Input issue in the pause menu on the Bonus stage.
[*] Input issue on the Bonus stage when getting the radish.
[*] Points multiplier when enemies are in "Scatter" mode.
[/list]

[h3]Changed
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Default leaderboard scores and stages are more clear, organized, and more challenging to get to the 1st position.
[*] Extra life is now set at 75000 points.
[*] Murti goes a little faster on the Bonus stage.
[*] Press and hold "1p_start" + "1p_button1" on the logos screen to access the Test menu.
[/list]

Artwork by https://twitter.com/KevinFagaragan

notes.title: New update: v1.1.3 is out!
notes.notes:
[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Low processor mode when the window is not focused.
[*] New icon.
[*] "Talpy" can only attack again after reaching the next tile.
[/list]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Default bezel to 1.
[*] Default volume to 50%.
[*] Fullscreen by default.
[*] Reorganized options.
[*] Tweaked color aberration on the CRT filter.
[*] "Credits" screen now has auto-scroll (instead of pagination).
[*] "Kill" for "Defeat".
[/list]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Audio volume progression.
[*] Going to "Main" screen after getting a high score (demo)
[/list]

notes.title: New update: v1.1.2 is out!
notes.notes:
This new version includes many bug fixes, optimizations, and some new features.

[h3]Added[/h3]

[list]
[*] Mini tutorial the first time playing.
[*] Scroll on the "Options screen".
[*] New secret bonus stage.
[*] Skip "PreStage" screen by pressing "cancel".
[*] "yes/no" buttons in "Continue" screen.
[*] Reset score after continuing.
[*] "Bonus Stage" is now pausable.
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]

[list]
[*] Input issues with joystick and D-Pad being map to the same action.
[*] Button icons for the different platforms/controllers.
[*] Loading older JSON and store in the new format.
[*] Audio volume progression.
[*] Credit being reset on "Main menu" screen. Now it's only reset aftet not continuing.
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]

[list]
[*] Reworked some collisions boxes, so Murti has more chances of escaping the explosions.
[*] Movement is more fluid now.
[*] Extra life every 80000 points.
[*] Tweaked CRT filter's opacity.
[*] Less chromatic aberration on the CRT filter.
[*] More time to read the "Self System Test" screen.
[*] Always to to "game over" screen after dying. Then:
[list]
[*] If the player has a high score, go to "Enter name" screen" and the to "Continue" screen.
[*] If not, go to "Continue" screen.
[/list]
[/list]
